title: "See DOCX live-refresh smoke fixture"
author: "See DOCX"

# First section

This fixture deliberately contains enough repeated prose to span multiple
pages. The smoke test opens its generated DOCX, scrolls to a position well
away from the start, touches the watched output, and verifies that the viewer
returns to the same page and relative vertical position after rendering.

The document viewer is intended for Markdown workflows where a separate build
process creates a DOCX artifact. A refresh should replace the displayed PDF
without forcing the reader to rediscover their position in the document.

## Repeated material

The purpose of this paragraph is to provide ordinary flowing text for a Word document. A dependable smoke fixture should avoid special features and ensure that a standard page layout produces several scrollable pages.

The live preview has a deliberately modest responsibility. It renders the generated DOCX faithfully enough to inspect the final artifact, notices a replacement written by a Markdown build, and keeps the reader anchored in the document while the replacement becomes visible. This longer fixture paragraph supplies stable, ordinary prose so that the test has several page boundaries to navigate and a non-trivial vertical position to restore.
